calcdir.formula: angle = atan2(targetX - currentX, -(targetZ - currentZ)) / 3.141592 * 180.0; assign to m_roty, subtract 360 once if >=360, add 360 once if <0.
calcdir.evidence: The primary decomp body at Ref/GameActor.cpp:1021-1034 is labeled with the four-coordinate signature but decompiles as object-relative CalcDir(this,x,z), using this->m_pos as origin. The four-coordinate equivalent is explicit in Ref/dhxj/GameActor.cpp:396-405 and annotated at src/world/RagEffect.cpp:24885-24893 as VA 0x5552D0. Player.cpp:278 calls the four-coordinate form with player's current position and GetClientCoor's result.

raw_mode152_direction.evidence: Player.cpp:278-334 computes target angle v23, then a wrapped angular difference from current m_roty (add 360 when negative), rounds to nearest 45-degree sector with floor((delta+22.5)*1/45), and selects head/body turn. Sectors 0/4 face target with head=0; 1 and 7 first turn head (if not already there), otherwise body; 2/3 set head=1 and body angle target+45; 5/6 set head=2 and body angle target-45. The sent mode152 arguments are raw packetDir=(int)((int64)m_roty+180)/45 % 8 and headDir. Current mode message handling maps message 152 at src/gamemode/GameMode.cpp:11021 to SendChangeDirRequestPacket(head=lparam,dir=wparam,normalizeDir=false), so it preserves that already-quantized direction byte.

ApplyLocalPlayerDirection reconstructs m_roty as 45*(dir+4), updates seated action/motion and PC headDir. The port operates from target direction octant, whereas the original Player message16 path derives that octant from the requested target grid-cell center and continuous world angle.
